bridge.scope: Fail-closed admin authentication regression for protected bounty-payment endpoints

environment.description: Independent VPS rerun against current MyZubster code using targeted Jest coverage

steps: Run the targeted admin-auth regression tests.
Verify unconfigured ADMIN_API_KEY rejects protected access.
Verify the correct configured credential is accepted.

observation.summary: The independently reproduced fail-closed admin-auth checkpoint passed all four bounded authorization cases.

limitations: This checkpoint is bounded to the tested admin-auth regression.
It does not establish whole-system security or penetration-test coverage.
It does not infer payment, employment, certification or governance authority.
